On The Tee

Ankeny's Newest Clubhouse Grill

Birdie's Tavern + Grill opened its doors in October 2025 — bringing Ankeny a laid-back spot where the food is made with real care and nobody takes themselves too seriously. Think a neighborhood grill with a golf swing mixed into it.

Every burger is hand-smashed to order, the wings come five ways, and regulars swear by the hot-honey Brussels sprouts. Whether you're grabbing lunch after a round, catching the game at the bar, or bringing the family in for dinner, you'll get good food, cold drinks, and great company every time.
